items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was Foots Thomas and Andrew Brown and Lammar Wright.

ctx.x: ’38, ’39. Cab is breaking up the band. The band was the Missourians band before. When he joined the band, they put him in front of the Missourians band. The band had survived. That’s the band David Jones had been in. Never heard him, because after I joined the band, I never . . . them half a dozen musicians who were still there, they never spoke to nobody, because they resented they were being chopped off, like you chop off a cake. One at a time. Cab was getting rid of them, because he was mad when they didn’t…
Foots Thomas played sax with Jelly Roll, right?
